source_snapshot.test_name_items: Mechanical Check w/ Drive Full Populated
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check any mechanical problem found during insert all HDD in the SUT.

1. Plug HDD into HDD slot.
2. Repeat Step 1 until to all the HDD slots on system are occupied by HDDs.
3. Remove 1 HDD from HDD slot.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. System chasiss has no mechanical issue when all the HDD slots are occupied by HDDs.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Physical/visual drive seating, lever and full-population chassis inspection requires an operator.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO; correctly identifies full-population fit and removal as physical/visual work.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED; adds complete slot inventory, safe handling, qualified operator and evidence requirements.
historical_reviews.round_02: No separate exact-code round-02 entry was found.

original_test_intent: Verify that the chassis can be fully populated with the specified drives and carriers without binding, interference, misalignment, damaged connectors/latches or structural issues, and that a representative drive can then be removed normally.
original_method: A qualified hardware operator maps every bay and drive/carrier, makes the platform safe for service, inserts drives sequentially until all bays are occupied, inspects seating/latches/clearance/chassis behavior, removes the designated representative drive and records per-bay and full-population evidence.
manual_activity: The core is repeated physical insertion, tactile/visual fit inspection under full chassis population and physical removal of one drive. The agent cannot manipulate the carriers, judge insertion/latch force or observe chassis interference and must not claim completion.
required_inputs: Exact chassis/backplane/bay revisions and total bay count
Approved drives, carriers/trays, interposers and per-bay mapping
Hot-swap versus powered-off service state, workload/data disposition and ESD/weight controls
Assembly/latch/force/clearance acceptance criteria and representative removal bay
Qualified operator plus required photo/video/checklist format
safety_requirements: Use the platform's approved powered-off or hot-swap procedure and verify no protected/in-use storage will be disrupted.
Confirm carrier orientation and bay mapping; never force a drive or latch.
Stop on binding, abnormal force, incomplete seating, connector/latch damage, chassis flex, unstable rack/chassis or thermal/airflow obstruction.
Preserve the as-found configuration; do not repeatedly cycle a suspect bay or improvise mechanical modification.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare the complete bay/drive/carrier matrix and safe-state/evidence checklist.
Receive and correlate operator-attributed per-bay/full-population/removal photos and findings; optionally organize read-only inventory/log evidence after assembly.
Report coverage gaps and mechanical exceptions as Tool Result without claiming physical completion or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve service/hot-swap state, population matrix and physical acceptance criteria.
Perform and attest all insertions, full-population inspection and one-drive removal.
Determine disposition of any fit/latch/interference issue and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No remote command can establish seating force, latch action, full-population clearance or removal mechanics; its manual boundary is correct.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Do not replace the mechanical test with storage enumeration. Read-only device/backplane inventory is supplemental only after the operator completes the physical sequence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Populate every HDD slot, remove one HDD, inspect chassis mechanics and 10/0-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a numbered bay map with carrier/drive identifiers, standardized insertion/latch/clearance observations, photos at partial and full population, airflow/cover checks and documented representative removal.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis, backplane, carrier and drive mechanical revisions and assembly-SOP version.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project mechanical drawings, carrier/backplane service manual and hot-swap SOP must define safe handling.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds per-bay traceability, service-state protection and complete evidence without changing the hands-on method.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; every bay must be populated and one specified drive removed.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Full hardware matrix and mechanical criteria.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Software enumeration cannot detect excessive force, latch interference or structural stress.

project_override_considerations: A project may define drive/carrier variants and representative removal bay. If fewer than all physical bays are populated, the report must state reduced project scope and cannot claim master full-population completion.
expected_evidence: Chassis/backplane/bay and drive/carrier inventory with operator identity and safe-state approval
Full-population chassis/clearance/cover/airflow evidence and representative removal observation
Any mechanical stop plus supplemental inventory/log state, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion consistently require full drive population without chassis mechanical issues, including one removal action.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The physical scope is clear. Missing drives/operator or criteria are readiness inputs; the hands-on tactile/visual core is MANUAL ONLY.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with human-only physical execution and expands evidence beyond generic seating.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with MANUAL ONLY and retains full inventory, safe handling and stop-on-damage boundaries.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds protected-storage/hot-swap distinction, every-bay coverage accounting and a non-equivalence boundary for software inventory.

review_improvement: Creates auditable full-population coverage and protects drives, connectors and active storage while preserving manual ownership.
independent_technical_reasoning: The measured conditions are mechanical fit, latch behavior and chassis interference under a full physical population. These require human manipulation and observation, so the complete case is MANUAL ONLY regardless of any supplemental OS inventory.
